name: Kosovo
description: Kosovo from Dardania and medieval Serbia to the Ottomans, Yugoslavia, the war of 1998 and 1999 and independence in 2008.

checkpoints.name: Medieval Kosovo
checkpoints.note: Kosovo was a heart of the medieval Serbian state, with its great monasteries. The Ottomans won the battle of Kosovo in 1389.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman and Yugoslav rule
checkpoints.note: The Ottomans ruled for four centuries. Kosovo went to Serbia in 1912 and was part of Yugoslavia, where Albanians became the great majority.

checkpoints.name: War and independence
checkpoints.note: War broke out in 1998 and NATO bombed Yugoslavia in 1999. Kosovo declared independence in 2008; many states recognise it and Serbia does not.
